## Company Overview
SKEQI (思客琦) is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment, delivering comprehensive smart manufacturing solutions anchored by proprietary hardware systems. [1] **Verified**
The company is headquartered at No. 115 Shugang Road, Jiaocheng District, Ningde City, Fujian Province, China. [1][6] **Verified**
It operates four major industrial manufacturing bases located in Ningde (Jiaocheng & Dongqiao campuses), Shanghai (Songjiang), and Dalian (Beihai). [3][4] **Verified**
Corporate scale reports indicate a workforce of approximately 2,000 employees, though precise headcounts fluctuate and are not officially quantified beyond ranges. [3][4][6] **Verified**
A founding year discrepancy exists: official channels omit it, whereas third-party recruitment materials cite 2012, and a corporate registry excerpt notes 2016; applying source priority rules, neither first-party nor consistent cross-referencing resolves the gap. **Not enough evidence**

## Main Products & Services
New Energy Intelligent Equipment: Provides full-process automation covering cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging, and battery recycling/disassembly. [1] **Verified**
QIHANG Digital Factory System: A self-developed 5G-enabled industrial management platform integrating WMS, MES, supply chain tracking, and big-data visual dashboards for end-to-end production digitization. [1] **Verified**
Kepile Intelligent Logistics: Offers flexible smart transport, smart warehousing, and non-standard automated logistics subsystems tailored for factory automation upgrades. [1] **Verified**
Laser Application Technology: Delivers turnkey laser solutions emphasizing welding, energy control, and beam-shaping technologies with rapid core-component turnaround. [1] **Verified**
Industrial Non-Destructive Testing (NDT): Manufactures high-end 2D/3D X-ray inspection equipment for detecting defects in battery cells, semiconductor soldering, automotive parts, and aerospace components. [1] **Verified**
Precision Manufacturing & Automotive Lines: Supplies custom molds, precision plastics/hardwares, and fully automated welding lines for auto body/chassis fabrication. [1] **Verified**
IP Portfolio: Maintains over 240 registered patents, including recent devices like a secondary-positioning slide for taped-cell pre-stacking to prevent misalignment. [2] **Verified**

## Industries / Markets Served
Primary vertical: New energy battery manufacturing. [1] **Verified**
Secondary verticals: Automobile & component manufacturing, 3C electronics, photovoltaic/solar energy, grid-scale storage, special-purpose vehicles, and aerospace. [1][3][4] **Verified**
Geographic footprint: Strong domestic penetration in China, with active commercial expansion into Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America. [3][4] **Verified**

## Customer Segments
Top-tier lithium battery manufacturers requiring high-capacity pack/module lines. [3][4] **Verified**
Automotive OEMs (both NEV startups and legacy brands) needing lightweight, automated body/chassis welding lines. [3][4] **Verified**
Photovoltaic and energy storage developers scaling gigafactory infrastructure. [3][4] **Verified**
Specialty vehicle makers undergoing electrification retrofits or new model launches. [1] **Verified**
Broad industrial clients seeking modular automation, digitalization, and precision machining services. [1] **Likely / partially supported**

## Key Customers / Partners
*First-Party Claims (Official Website [1]):* CATL, EVE Energy, CALB (中创新航), Gotion High-tech, XPeng, Leapmotor, Linde Materials Handling, Hangcha Group. [1] **Verified**
*Third-Party Claims (Campus Recruitment/Media [3][4]):* Ruipu Energy, Audi, BMW, Ford Motor, Geely, SAIC Motors, Jinko Solar, Hithium Energy. [3][4] **Verified**
*Strategic/Award Partners:* Recognized by CATL with the “Best Equipment Quality Response Award”; featured speaker and award recipient at High Energy Storage/Lithium industry conferences. [1][3][4] **Verified**

## Competitive / Strategic Positioning
Market leadership claim: Asserts #1 domestic market share for module and PACK production lines. [3][4] **Verified**
Capacity scaling strategy: Rolling out a 260,000 sqm Phase II smart manufacturing base in Ningde to accelerate delivery cycles and lock in advanced capacity. [1] **Verified**
Technology-driven integration: Houses the IMATI Smart Manufacturing Advanced Technology Research Institute, systematically merging core process engineering with AI, 5G, and machine vision. [1] **Verified**
Value proposition: Emphasizes mature technology stacks, aggressive cost control, and guaranteed delivery SLAs to de-risk clients’ high-speed capacity deployments. [1] **Verified**
Global posture: Transitioning from domestic consolidation to structured overseas market penetration across three major continental regions. [3][4] **Verified**

## Differentiators
Full-lifecycle integration: Unique ability to deliver monolithic turnkey lines spanning electrochemical cell handling through PACK sealing and end-of-life battery disassembly. [1] **Verified**
Closed-loop digital stack: In-house QIHANG software natively couples with physical equipment and material handling, avoiding third-party middleware fragmentation. [1] **Verified**
Cross-pollination engineering: Combines laser optics, X-ray NDT, precision tooling, and robotics under one vendor umbrella, enabling highly customized non-standard automation. [1] **Verified**
Institutional credibility: Accumulated multiple national-tier recognitions including “Specialized & Innovative Little Giant,” “National Service-Oriented Manufacturing Demonstration Enterprise,” and provincial “Manufacturing Single Champion” status. [3][4] **Verified**

## Brand / Company Values
Explicit cultural pillars: Integrity (诚信), Innovation (创新), Responsibility (责任), Gratitude (感恩). [1] **Verified**
Mission framing: Positions itself as a technological catalyst for energy-sector modernization, prioritizing synergistic ecosystem building and continuous manufacturing paradigm shifts. [1] **Verified**

## Recent Relevant Developments
Facility ramp-up: Ningde Phase II production complex is entering phased operational commissioning to boost throughput. [1] **Verified**
Patent milestone: Successfully granted utility model CN224662069U for a taped-cell pre-stacking secondary positioning mechanism. [2] **Verified**
Industry awards & thought leadership: Received “2024 Enterprise of the Year” from High Energy Storage association, won the “15-Year Technology Leap” honor, and delivered keynote presentations on storage manufacturing energy-efficiency optimization. [1][3][4] **Verified**
Talent acquisition push: Actively running 2026 campus hiring programs targeting mechanical, process, electrical, machine vision, and algorithm engineers to sustain R&D velocity. [3] **Verified**

## Research Confidence / Gaps
Founding year mismatch: Official sources do not disclose a launch date, while third-party recruitment documents list 2012 and a corporate registry scrape indicates 2025 filing referencing 2016; conflicting tiers prevent resolution. **Not enough evidence**
Financial transparency: No revenue figures, gross margins, order backlog, R&D spend ratios, or CapEx allocations are disclosed across any provided source. **Not enough evidence**
Overseas commercial depth: Though global expansion is announced, specific foreign market revenue splits, localized partner networks, or post-sales service footprints remain unspecified. **Likely / partially supported**
Customer validation granularity: Several named accounts appear exclusively in third-party university posting sheets rather than official case study pages or press releases; tier-level engagement depth cannot be confirmed. **Verified (name recognition), but engagement scope: Not enough evidence**
Date artifact in patent record: One industry publication timestamp lists an August 2026 grant date, which contradicts standard historical sequencing and likely reflects a web-scraper metadata error. **Likely / partially supported**
